# Dvatone

> DVATONE is a Kyiv Architectural Multicolor Collection: a contemporary architectural collection of multicolour solutions, a water-based multicolour paint (multicolour decorative coating) for interiors. Its multicolour texture forms as the paint is sprayed on. The site is in Ukrainian at the root and in English under /en/.

Facts from Dvatone (see the FAQ page):

- The DVATONE collection is built on Dialcolor, the Belgian multicolour paint made by Trimetal (part of AkzoNobel), through an innovative paint preparation method that achieves the fine-granule result; Dvatone is its own system for selecting and making multicolour compositions.
- Water-based and odour-free; VOC content below 30 g/l.
- Highly wear-resistant and washable; it stands up to regular wet cleaning.
- A damaged spot can be repaired locally; once dry it blends into the wall with no visible seams.
- Base consumption from 200 ml/m². Made to order from 2 litres, in 1-litre steps.
- Any custom multicolour composition can be matched to NCS, RAL or Sikkens 5051. The DV collection was created together with interior designers.
- Recommended application: Rigo professional compressors (Italy) with a 2.5 mm nozzle. Dvatone offers turnkey application, on-site training and technical support.
- Base components are kept in stock in Ukraine; paint is shipped to any country.
- Contact: +38 098 698 69 90, info@dvatone.com, Telegram bot @Dvatone_bot (https://t.me/Dvatone_bot), Kyiv, Ukraine.
